The provided docs don't name a CLI command for listing running models. They document the API endpoint instead:

"List models that are currently loaded into memory." [ollama/docs/api.md]

The endpoint is `GET /api/ps`, shown as `curl http://localhost:11434/api/ps` [ollama/docs/api.md].

The only CLI command in the context is `ollama list`, which the docs use to confirm that models are available, not which are running: "Run `ollama list` and confirm that models are available." [ollama/docs/integrations/vscode.md]

I don't know from these documents whether a CLI command for running models exists. Outside these docs, I believe Ollama has an `ollama ps` command, but I can't confirm that from the provided context.
